title: Lower left closed-band density of ν is at most the lower left Dini derivative of its distribution function on (a,b) (parent Step 4 / (5a))
statement: Let ν be a Borel measure on ℝ and a, b ∈ ℝ with ν((a,b)) < ∞. Let G(r) := ν((a,b) ∩ (−∞, r]), taken as a real number (toReal). Then for every t ∈ (a,b), liminf_{h→0+} ν([t − h, t])/ofReal(h) ≤ liminf_{k→0+} ofReal((G(t) − G(t − k))/k). Both liminfs are taken in [0, ∞] along 𝓝[>] 0, and the quotient on the left is division in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (ν : Measure ℝ) (a b : ℝ), ν (Ioo a b) ≠ ∞ → ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ν (Icc (t - h) t) / ENNReal.ofReal h) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ liminf (fun k : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (((ν (Ioo a b ∩ Iic t)).toReal - (ν (Ioo a b ∩ Iic (t - k))).toReal) / k)) (𝓝[>] 0)
